name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Antichain Number
details: For every finite binary class, no-clashing teaching dimension dominates the antichain number.
proof: Start with a no-clashing teacher map of width $d$. Pad each assigned sample, with examples consistent with its target, until it has size exactly $d$. This preserves no-clashing. Distinct equal-size samples cannot strictly contain one another, and no-clashing excludes equality, so the padded map is an antichain teacher mapping of width $d$. Hence $\mathrm{AN}\le\mathrm{NCTD}$.
witness_verification: For $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{NC/AN}}$, the established values are $\mathrm{NCTD}=2$ and $\mathrm{AN}=1$; the exhaustive certificate is $\texttt{sync/verify\_noclashing\_antichain\_gap.py}$.
